import pandas as pd
u = pd.read_csv('utilization.csv')
c = pd.read_csv('instance_catalog.csv')
u = u.merge(c, on='instance_type', suffixes=('_cur',''))
u['required_vcpu'] = u.vcpu * u.p95_cpu_pct/100 / 0.7
u['required_mem'] = u.memory_gib * u.p95_mem_pct/100 / 0.8

def rec(row):
    fam = c[c.family == row.family]
    cand = fam[(fam.vcpu >= row.required_vcpu) & (fam.memory_gib >= row.required_mem)]
    if cand.empty:
        return row.instance_type
    return cand.sort_values('hourly_usd').iloc[0].instance_type

u['recommended'] = u.apply(rec, axis=1)
u2 = u.merge(c[['instance_type','hourly_usd']].rename(columns={'instance_type':'rec_type','hourly_usd':'rec_hourly'}), left_on='recommended', right_on='rec_type')
u2['saving'] = (u2.hourly_usd - u2.rec_hourly) * 730
print(u2[['instance_id','instance_type','recommended','hourly_usd','rec_hourly','saving']].head(10))
print(u2.saving.sum())
